places.name: Amazon Rainforest
places.ai_summary: A vast and biodiverse rainforest offering unique wildlife, lush vegetation, and opportunities for eco-tourism and adventure.
places.place_tip: Bring insect repellent and waterproof gear.

places.name: Belén Market
places.ai_summary: A vibrant market offering exotic fruits, local crafts, and a glimpse into the daily life of Iquitos residents.
places.place_tip: Try the local exotic fruits and dishes.

places.name: Amazon River
places.ai_summary: The second longest river in the world, offering stunning views, diverse wildlife, and opportunities for river cruises and fishing.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera and binoculars for wildlife spotting.

places.name: Pacaya Samiria National Reserve
places.ai_summary: A vast protected area in the Amazon rainforest, known for its biodiversity, river cruises, and guided jungle tours.
places.place_tip: Book a guided tour for a complete experience.

places.name: Belen Floating Market
places.ai_summary: A unique market where vendors sell their goods from boats, offering a variety of products from food to handicrafts.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the local breakfast dishes.

places.name: Manatee Rescue Center
places.ai_summary: A conservation center dedicated to the rescue and rehabilitation of manatees and other Amazonian wildlife.
places.place_tip: Call ahead to confirm tour times.

places.name: Quistococha Lagoon
places.ai_summary: A beautiful lagoon located just outside Iquitos, popular for swimming, picnicking, and observing wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the scenery.

places.name: Pilpintuwasi Butterfly Farm
places.ai_summary: A butterfly farm and conservation center, home to a variety of butterfly species and other exotic insects.
places.place_tip: Wear bright colors to attract butterflies.

places.name: Plaza de Armas Iquitos
places.ai_summary: The main square of Iquitos, surrounded by historic buildings, shops, and restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: A great place to relax and people-watch.

places.place_tip: Visit the surrounding shops and cafes.

places.name: Iron House (Casa de Fierro)
places.ai_summary: A historic iron house designed by Gustave Eiffel, now serving as a museum and cultural center.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Plaza de Armas.

places.name: Tarapacá River Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic riverside walk offering views of the Tarapacá River, local wildlife, and the opportunity to see traditional Amazonian homes.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring water and wear comfortable shoes.

places.name: Amazon Jungle Lodges
places.ai_summary: Eco-friendly lodges located in the Amazon rainforest, offering a unique and immersive jungle experience.
places.place_tip: Pack light and be prepared for a digital detox.

places.name: Monkey Island Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: A wildlife sanctuary dedicated to the rescue and rehabilitation of monkeys and other wildlife species.
places.place_tip: Call ahead to confirm tour times.

places.name: Nauta Town & Amazon Source Point
places.ai_summary: A town located at the confluence of the Marañón and Ucayali rivers, considered the birthplace of the Amazon River.
places.place_tip: Visit the local market and try the fresh fish.

places.name: Amazon Rescue Centre
places.ai_summary: A center dedicated to the rescue and rehabilitation of Amazonian wildlife, including birds, mammals, and reptiles.
places.place_tip: Call ahead to confirm tour times.

places.name: Ethnographic Museum of the Amazon
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the ethnography and cultural history of the Amazonian peoples.
places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Iron House.

places.name: Belén Shantytown Tour (Guided)
places.ai_summary: A guided tour through the Belén shantytown, offering insights into the lives of local residents and the opportunity to try local foods.

opening_hours.notes: Book in advance for guided tours.

places.place_tip: Respect local customs and ask before taking photos.

places.name: Amazon Canopy Walkway
places.ai_summary: A suspended walkway in the Amazon rainforest, offering a unique perspective of the jungle and its wildlife.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring water.

places.name: Ayahuasca Cultural Retreats (Ethical Visits)
places.ai_summary: Retreats offering the traditional Amazonian experience of Ayahuasca ceremonies, led by local shamans.

opening_hours.notes: Book in advance and ensure ethical practices.

places.place_tip: Prepare for a spiritual and physical journey.

places.name: Evening Malecon Boulevard Lights
places.ai_summary: A scenic walk along the Malecon Boulevard in the evening, enjoying the views of the Itaya River and the city lights.
places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket, it can be cool by the river.

places.name: Birdwatching Excursions
places.ai_summary: Guided excursions for birdwatching enthusiasts, exploring the diverse avifauna of the Amazon rainforest.
places.place_tip: Bring binoculars and a bird guidebook.

attribution.title: Antigua Iglesia de Tarapoto, 1952
attribution.author: Parleve89
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
attribution.description: Una foto histórica del 1952 donde se puede apreciar el primigenio templo parroquial de Tarapoto, que ocupaba toda una manzana (desde la calle Jiménez Pimentel hasta la Martínez de Compañón). Fue demolida, y actualmente ubicada en la tienda Topitop al frente de la Plaza de Armas.

places.name: Sunset Cruise on Amazon River
places.ai_summary: A relaxing cruise on the Amazon River at sunset, offering stunning views and the chance to see river wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Book in advance for popular cruises.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and binoculars.
